demand_signals.source: Indian home-decor retailers listing 2x3 ft cotton dhurries
demand_signals.summary: Pepperfry (Rs 739), Vibecity (Rs 960 out of stock; Rs 3,200), Urban Ladder (Rs 6,000) and Flipkart (Rs 496) list 2x3 ft dhurries/rugs. Shows the format is actively retailed; no sales volume data found.

risks: Supplier snippet gives no seller name, city or MOQ for the Rs 165-168 listings. Need a written quote for single-piece drop-ship at <= ~Rs 203 incl. packing, plus photos with permission.
Flipkart has a 2x3 ft rug at Rs 496 (material ambiguous). Marketplace shoppers may compare on price; Amazon.in not checked.
Weight not confirmed. A 2x3 ft cotton dhurrie is usually well under 1 kg, but get the packed weight from the supplier; slab le_1kg assumed.
Colour/weave variation in handloom items and possible colour bleed on first wash; listing must say 'dry clean / gentle hand wash, colours may vary'.
Do not claim '100% cotton' or 'handloom' without supplier confirmation (Handloom Mark if claiming handloom).
GST: 5% assumed for cotton dhurries (HSN 5702). CA to confirm.
Not fragile, not electrical, not a blocked category.

review.notes: Rs 699 does not hold: Pepperfry sells Saral Home 2x3 ft hand-woven cotton dhurries at Rs 569-599 (a 2-pack at Rs 569) and machine-made at Rs 379. At a realistic Rs 569 the Shopify margin is 30.4% only at the unverified Rs 168 snippet cost (fails the worse case) and drops to 23.7% at Rs 203. The cost comes from a search snippet with no seller, MOQ, packing or GST, so the margin is not proven.

review.weight_check: Listed weights for 2x3 ft cotton dhurries are 0.8 kg (Pepperfry Art India) and 1 kg (Pepperfry Sashaa World; Urban Ladder Unik), all from search snippets on 2026-11-14. le_1kg is plausible, but a 1 kg rug plus packing may go over 1 kg into le_2kg. Packed weight from the supplier is still needed.
review.fragile_flag: In recommend.py 'fragile' is an economics flag: it passes the base case but fails the worse case for returns, ads or shipping. It does not mean physical breakage. The dhurrie is not glass_fragile and has no breakage risk in transit. At Rs 699 the flag is set because the margin is thin, not because the item breaks.
review.not_found: Amazon.in and Meesho prices for 2x3 ft cotton dhurries were not found in 4 searches. The Meesho listing (https://www.meesho.com/prisha-handloom-fancy-kitchen-mat-doormatbath-mat-floormat-rugs/p/f734lt) showed no price. No complaint data was gathered.
review.reopen_if: A named supplier quotes a single-piece drop-ship at or below Rs 168 including packing and GST, gives a packed weight of 1 kg or less, and provides photos with permission. The product would then need to be relisted at about Rs 569 and re-run.
